QuestInfo.name: To the Gray City, Kerning City
QuestInfo.0: #p229#, the Town Clerk of #m10001000#, seems to have another proposal.
QuestInfo.1: Town Clerk #p229# of #m10001000# recommended listening to the explanation in #m10003000# as well before deciding which city to become a resident of. \r\n#rOnly characters at Level 12 or higher can complete this quest.#k
QuestInfo.2: City Clerk #p425#, whom I met in #m10003000#, suggested that I become a resident of #m10003000#. Which city suits me better, #m10001000# or #m10003000#? Once I make up my mind, I should speak with the City Clerk of that city for more details.

0.0: Hmm, now that I think about it, I believe it's important to gather enough information before making such a big decision. While our town of #m10001000# is a wonderful place to live, #m10003000# is also known to be a charming place full of unique character.
0.1: I really think it would be best for you to visit #m10003000# yourself and see which town suits you better. It won't be too late to choose #m10001000# even after you've given both places a fair comparison!

yes.0: Great! If you head west from here, you'll reach #m10003000#. Why don't you go and meet #b#p425##k, the City Clerk over there, and see what she has to say?

no.0: Have you already made up your mind?

1.0: Oh my, an adventurer, aren't you? Is this your first time in #m10003000#? No need to look so surprised. It’s quite rare to see someone wandering around this city with such an innocent, naive look on their face. You can't hide it from me.
1.1: Ah, I see you’ve already met #p229# in #m10001000#. That guy has always been needlessly earnest and uptight. Well, that makes things quick. Mind if we make a very special proposal to you as well?
1.2: Responsibility, rules, reputation... isn't a life bound by such tedious things incredibly suffocating? Haven't you ever felt like your true self is just slipping away while you're too busy worrying about what others think?
1.3: You see, #m10003000# is a city open to anyone who pursues a life of complete freedom, unbound by anything. The residents here live their lives entirely on their own terms, without caring about the judgment of others.
1.4: That being said, it’ll be trouble if you mistake this for a free pass to do whatever you want. If you cross the line by bullying the weak or the innocent, you won't escape 'His' severe punishment. You want to know who He is? You'll find out soon enough if you stay here.
1.5: Anyway, that's why we've decided to #bgrant adventurers the opportunity to become residents of this town#k, so that those who share our goals in life can freely settle down here. If you happen to be interested in obtaining #b#m10003000# Citizenship#k, feel free to ask me anytime!

level.0: Could you please speak to me again after you reach Level 12 or higher?
